notes.title: Announcement of Regularly Updated Maintenance (Server 14) 20250923
notes.content:
Dear Players:

We will conduct a maintenance update[b] from 10:00 to 12:00 am on September 23, 2025, Beijing time[/b]. The specific maintenance progress will be advanced or postponed depending on the maintenance progress. Thanks for your understanding. During this period, the game will be inaccessible and we are sorry for the inconvenience caused.

The following are the main contents of this maintenance:

[b][Updates][/b]

1. New Synthesis Creature: [b]Half-Elf[/b]
2. New categories for [b]Activity/Quests[/b]: “Pet Island” and “Infernal Tower”

[b][Event][/b]

[b]1.Supremacy: Archangel Michael
2.Red Diamond Storm: Red Diamond*2000 / Angel Box*1 / Silver*50,000

6.Special Benefit
7.Daily Tear Pack Big Rebate
8.Value Rebates
9.Directory of Myths (Zhong Kui)
10.Event of Horsehair
11.Gold Rush (Weekly Event)[/b]
[u]Consume 10,000 gold coins: Minister Gil (Legendary)*1, Solar Chest (Legendary)*2. Pet Pleasure*1

[b]12.Spend Daily, Get Rewards[/b]
[u]Consume 100 gold coins: Fusion Catalyst*1, Silver*10,000, Tower Ticket*3
Consume 500 gold coins: Human Box (Rare)*1, Fusion Catalyst*2, Chaotic Wastes Ticket*1

20 packs of Specialist Pack V - Specialist Pack V*10 / Silver*1,000,000

17.Heaven's Rapture[/b]

See the pictures for details. The event content is subject to the game content. The official has the final right of interpretation.

notes.title: Special Offer Shop Now Open Once a Month: Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players,

Thank you for your continued support and love for the game. In order to better balance the in-game economy and enhance the player experience, we have carefully considered and decided to adjust the opening frequency of the Special Offer Shop starting next month.

[b]The specific changes are as follows:
- Original plan: Open once a week
- Now adjusted to: Open once a month[/b]

We believe this adjustment will create a healthier in-game economic environment and give every player more time to plan their resources and game progress effectively.

The purpose of this change is to:
1. Provide more strategic thinking opportunities, making each opening of the Special Offer Shop a special event worth anticipating.
2. Better regulate in-game resources and spending, avoiding the imbalance caused by too frequent Special Offers.
3. Better cater to the needs of various players, especially those with limited resources and time.

[u][b]Additionally, please note that the Discount Shop on April 8th will be the last one for April![/b][/u]

We understand that this change may affect some players, but we believe it is an important step for the long-term development of the game. We will continue to monitor your feedback to ensure that each opening of the Special Offer Shop provides the best gaming experience.

Once again, thank you for your support and understanding! The final interpretation rights belong to the [i]火焰征程 [/i]team!

notes.title: Preview of Weapon Special Effects Update for
notes.content:
Dear Players,

In order to enhance the gameplay experience and visual effects, we will be conducting a comprehensive update of the weapon special effects in the near future. This update will add more dazzling and expressive special effects to various weapons, not only enhancing the visual impact of combat but also providing players with a more immersive and diverse sense of hitting power.

Update Details:

[b]1.Weapon Attack Special Effects Overhaul[/b]
We have reworked the attack special effects for several weapons. The new effects are more refined, delivering a stronger visual impact. Every strike has been carefully crafted, allowing players to feel the power and strength of their weapons more clearly in battle.

notes.title: “火焰征程” Fashion Update Preview
notes.content:
Dear Players,

  We are thrilled to announce that[i][b] 火焰征程[/b][/i] is about to bring you a major and highly anticipated update—[b]the Fashion System[/b]!
  [b]The Fashion System is designed to offer players a wide range of character appearance customization options. With fashion, your character can have a cool and unique style, featuring various themed outfits including holiday, tech, fantasy, and more![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/4f4c2b321ddd1d55a121f2fa05c91d0b7ce2cfb0.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/91217bed54f33deea8f4497c6ff8d6c7397a3b55.gif[/img]
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
 [b]Fashion items come with both time-limited and permanent durations. Once obtained, they can be equipped from the "Character" tab in your backpack. Fashion items are categorized into five tiers based on quality: Exquisite, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Unprecedented. Players can obtain fashion items of various quality levels through different channels. The higher the fashion tier, the richer the special effects and higher the attributes. Fashion items can also be linked with your equipped mount, adding unique features to your beloved steed.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/990b967cbc844996fda781f316628a2c00e1399c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/a9ac0ce6ef6a8a4ca35ed94e64d26be12a20f99c.gif[/img]
(Actual effects may vary based on the final in-game version)
[b]What’s even more exciting is that fashion comes with attribute bonuses, boosting stats such as health, block, and critical strike, helping you dominate the battlefield. Experience a whole new style of combat today![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/a3a1ae9c0fd0b9aef775ddecf6c5083ce91959d6.png[/img]
  That’s all for today's preview of the new content. We believe these new features will bring you a more enriched and enjoyable gaming experience. Please stay tuned for further announcements on our official platforms to learn more about the update details and release time.
  Thank you for your ongoing support and love for [i][b]火焰征程[/b][/i]! We look forward to seeing you discover more exciting content in the new version and enjoy the fresh gaming experience!

tags.feature: The Fashion System is designed to offer players a wide range of character appearance customization options. With fashion, your character can have a cool and unique style, featuring various themed outfits including holiday, tech, fantasy, and more!

Fashion items come with both time-limited and permanent durations. Once obtained, they can be equipped from the "Character" tab in your backpack. Fashion items are categorized into five tiers based on quality: Exquisite, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Unprecedented. Players can obtain fashion items of various quality levels through different channels. The higher the fashion tier, the richer the special effects and higher the attributes. Fashion items can also be linked with your equipped mount, adding unique features to your beloved steed.

What’s even more exciting is that fashion comes with attribute bonuses, boosting stats such as health, block, and critical strike, helping you dominate the battlefield. Experience a whole new style of combat today!

notes.title: National Day-themed Event is Coming
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are excited to announce that on [b]October 1, 2024, Beijing Time(UTC+8)[/b], a brand new National Day special dungeon and events will be updated in the game!

[b]Covered Servers: S1-S9[/b]

[b]Event1:[/b]

[b]National Day Dungeon: [i]Lucky Journey[/i][/b]
[b]Dungeon Features: [/b]In this dungeon, players will embark on a journey to sunny beaches. Waves crash on the shore, and mysterious treasures are hidden in the sand. Players must avoid sudden attacks from seagulls, defeat monsters disguised in sandcastles, and explore the mysterious ruins at the end of the coast to earn precious rewards and unique items.
There are first-pass rewards and clearance rewards for the "[b][i]Fastest Challenge of National Day.[/i][/b]"
[b]Unlock Conditions: [i]Level 30[/i][/b]
[b]Opening Time: 0:00 on October 1, 2024 - 0:00 on October 8, 2024 (Beijing Time)[/b]

[b]Event2:[/b]

[b]National Day Legend Return Store[/b]
To celebrate the National Day, the game will launch the [b]Legend Returns Store & Legend Exchange Event[/b] for a limited time [b]from 0:00 on October 1st to 0:00 on October 8th, 2024, Beijing Time[/b]! The Legend Return Store will launch [b]Legend Master Packs I~VI[/b], and different activity points can be obtained by purchasing different card packs. Activity points can be used to exchange cards, props and other items in Legend Exchange.

Note:
[b]1. [Legend Returns] store card packs have a purchase limit, and the purchase limit is reset at 24:00 every day on the server time;
2. [Legend Exchange] items have a redemption limit during the event period, and the redemption limit will not be reset, and the redemption will end when all are redeemed;
3. The points will be cleared at the end of the redemption event, please redeem and use them in time;
4. The final right of interpretation of this event belongs to the operation team.[/b]

notes.title: "火焰征程" version update revelation
notes.content:
Dear players,
We are very happy to announce that "火焰征程" will bring you a series of exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. The following are the main contents of the new features:
1. [b]New version of novice guide[/b]
[b]Monologue Episode[/b] A new monologue will be added to the new guide, centered around the protagonist investigating the mysterious disappearance of an explorer during his quest. This episode will reveal more of the backstory and mission objectives, making the start of your game even more intriguing.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/dec7442ec554d4168bd8131d0f409668d03663e2.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/c9efa23544f9aae72d740507d72bf5481a5903ef.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/1efe3fb7d1bb4b7b536a05da72af4d1fb852a654.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/77c970c413e2881f584fb9baab9d4e1f30ddad59.png[/img]

[b]Icon guidance and character movement function[/b] In order to help players better explore the game world, we have introduced icon guidance and character movement functions to make the game scenes more vivid and real. With the movement of the game characters, you can not only see the dynamic movement of the characters in various scenes, but this function will also provide players with clear navigation guidance, so that you can find mission objectives and important scenes more easily.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/284ed27894c0ab46aa672826c91d9913b4fa987e.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/65b00141c79fd8143becc810296df75b957242fa.png[/img]

2. [b]New “World” entrance in the main city interface[/b]
[b]World function display[/b] The newly added "World" entrance will become an important window for you to understand the game world. "World" not only includes the original character movement function in the novice tutorial, but also allows you to see the explorers' waiting screen in the main city and the display scene of the top three explorers' glory moments.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/6fa5a774f9e1df9be15e8d9b6129d89eff90f1b3.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/f8a3d501e370168f2b94fe4d84231483a8d933dc.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/3823e50703edc8927fb7f99e0bd458d795c8e750.png[/img]

3. [b]Open pet system[/b]
[b]Pets fight side by side with players[/b] We have opened a new pet system. Each pet has unique skills and talents, which can provide players with additional attribute bonuses, such as attack, block, life, etc. In battle, pets will assist players in attacking enemies, reduce the pressure of your battle, and become a powerful partner on your adventure.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/5a8c8a653173e8d676951d6b299b70e889055f23.png[/img]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44693265/c0c259baf8b40097594b861bdb0bedbb0a4a5698.png[/img]

We believe that these new features will bring you a richer gaming experience and fun. Stay tuned to our official platform for more details on the update and when it will be available.
Thank you for your continuous support and love for “火焰征程”! We look forward to seeing you in the new version to discover more exciting content and enjoy a brand new gaming experience.

notes.title: Announcement of Game Special Card Customization on "火焰征程"
notes.content:
Dear "火焰征程" Game Players,

Thanks for your support and love for our game! To reciprocate the kindness of our players and provide a unique gaming experience for our esteemed VIP12 players, we have specially launched a [b]VIP12 Special Card Customization Service[/b]!

[b][Customization Content][/b]

1.**Style Customization**: Players can collaborate with our art team to create a one-of-a-kind card art style based on their preferences.

2. **Skill Customization**: Players can propose their ideal skill concepts and work with our game-planning team to craft exclusive and powerful skills.

[b][Customization Rules][/b]

1. This service is exclusively for players who have reached VIP12 status through recharge.

2. The customization of special cards will be carried out in the order of players reaching VIP12 status. Players who reach VIP12 first will receive priority for customization services.

3. During the customization process, please communicate and negotiate with our official team to ensure that the final product meets the expectations of both parties.

4. Once customization is complete, the special cards will serve as an exclusive benefit for VIP12 players and cannot be transferred, sold, or traded in any other way.

[b][Application Process][/b]

1. Players who have reached VIP12 through recharge should contact us via official email to submit a customization request.

2. We will contact you within 5 working days after receiving your application to begin the customization process.

3. During customization, please communicate with our team and provide timely feedback and confirmation on the progress.

4.Upon completion of customization, we will distribute the cards in-game and notify you via email.

[b]PS: Players can join the official discord and send a private message to Operations Personnel to apply for customization.

Official Discord Link: https://discord.gg/y4Q4PfGGgg[/b]

Thank you for your support and understanding! We look forward to providing a one-of-a-kind card experience for every VIP12 player! If you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us. Enjoy the game!

Best regards,

"火焰征程" Game Development Team

notes.title: **Game Account Transfer Announcement**
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are delighted to inform you that to cater to the diverse needs of our players and provide a richer gaming experience, we are introducing a service that allows players to transfer their accounts from the Chinese version to the English version of the game. Please note that this transfer service will involve some important changes to your account information. Kindly read the following instructions carefully:

1. **Transfer Contents**: This transfer service will only include your VIP level and historical recharge gold coin information. Other game data, such as progress, items,card， and equipment, will not be transferred. Please ensure that you have handled this information appropriately before deciding to transfer.

2. **Original Account Handling**: After the transfer, your original game account in the Chinese version will be deleted. Please make sure to back up all necessary information and confirm that you no longer need the original account before submitting the transfer request.

3. **Update on Transfer Process**: We will provide a transfer button within the game for players to submit their transfer information conveniently. Please note that this feature will be available after the next game update, so stay tuned.

4. **Important Reminder**: Before submitting the transfer request, please ensure that you have fully understood and accepted all the terms and conditions of this transfer service. Once the transfer is completed, it cannot be reversed or restored to its original state.

We sincerely thank you for your continuous support and love for the game, and we hope that this transfer service will bring you a better gaming experience. If you have any questions or suggestions during the transfer process, feel free to contact us anytime.

Happy Gaming!

Game Operation Team

**Note**: Please stay tuned to our update announcements for the latest game information and the specific opening time of the transfer service.

notes.title: Announcement on Fair Gameplay and Competition
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We deeply understand that fairness and competitiveness are crucial for safeguarding the interests of our players and enhancing their gaming experience. To ensure that every player can enjoy fair competition within our game, we hereby issue the following announcement:

**I. Strict Measures Against Malicious Score Boosting**

Malicious score boosting, which includes but is not limited to exploiting game vulnerabilities, using external cheats or hacks, employing boosting services, or any other unethical means to gain high scores or victories, severely undermines game balance and the spirit of competition. We will take a zero-tolerance approach to such behavior and impose severe penalties upon verification.

**II. Enhanced Supervision and Punitive Measures**

To effectively combat malicious score boosting, we will implement the following measures:

1. Strengthen Game Supervision: Through a combination of technical means and manual patrols, we will conduct real-time monitoring and prompt handling of any unusual activity within the game.
2. Improve Game Rules: We will continue to optimize game rules, reduce vulnerabilities, and enhance the fairness and competitiveness of the game.
3. Bolster Game Security: We will reinforce the protective measures of our game servers to prevent the infiltration of malicious programs such as cheats and hacks.
4. Implement Punitive Measures: For verified cases of malicious score boosting, we will impose penalties such as account bans, chat restrictions, and score deductions, depending on the severity of the offense.

**III. Promoting the Spirit of Fair Competition**

We urge all players to consciously abide by game rules and uphold the spirit of fair competition. Together, let us create a healthy and harmonious gaming environment. Please refrain from participating in any form of malicious score boosting to make our gaming world a better place.

**IV. Reporting and Feedback Mechanism**

If you encounter any player engaged in malicious score boosting or other violations within the game, please promptly report them to the game's official channels. We will carefully investigate each report and take appropriate action in accordance with our policies. Additionally, we welcome your valuable suggestions and feedback to help us continually improve and optimize the game.

Finally, we would like to express our gratitude to all players for your support and enthusiasm for our game. Let's work together to create a fair, just, and enjoyable gaming world!

Game Operations Team

notes.title: Game maintenance announcement 20231108
notes.content:
Dear game players,
Thank you for your continuous support and love. In order to provide a smoother gaming experience, we will carry out game maintenance on November 9th, 2023 at Beijing time. The maintenance is expected to start at 9:00 am and end at 6:00 pm. During this period, the game will be temporarily unable to log in. Please make advance arrangements to avoid any unnecessary troubles.
Here are the main contents of the maintenance:
1. Optimizing server network: We will optimize the game server network to improve network stability, reduce game delays and lag, and allow you to enjoy smooth operations in the game.
2. Card balance adjustment: We will make balance adjustments to some cards in the game to ensure fairness and competitiveness.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/b9e0d7a81b49cf968d2bb99d16805bc3d8cedf8f.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44693265/5beef51d3d2d4e10e75d3a97ab2841c817c46497.png[/img][/url]

Please note that all in-game activities will be suspended during the maintenance period. Please participate or claim related rewards as soon as possible. At the same time, in order to protect your game rights, please save your game progress in advance to avoid any unnecessary losses.
We apologize for the inconvenience caused by the maintenance and thank you for your understanding and support. After the maintenance is completed, you will be able to enjoy a better gaming experience. If you encounter any problems during the maintenance process, please feel free to contact our customer service team, and we will do our best to answer and handle your questions.
Thank you again for your attention and support for our game! Wishing you a pleasant gaming experience!
Flame Journey Game Operation Team on November 8th, 2023
